long_biography.plain_text:
Massimo Moratti’s decision to appoint José Mourinho as Inter Milan’s coach followed a run of domestic success under Roberto Mancini. Mourinho took the club to the 2010 treble, combining the Italian league, cup and Champions League titles. For Moratti, who bought Inter in 1995, ownership also meant close relationships with players he came to regard as friends.

He founded Inter Campus with his family and the club, using football to give disadvantaged children opportunities to play and learn. The programme worked with local partners across countries and developed activities for children with learning disabilities and young patients receiving cancer treatment.
long_biography.html:
Massimo Moratti’s decision to appoint José Mourinho as Inter Milan’s coach followed a run of domestic success under Roberto Mancini. Mourinho took the club to the 2010 treble, combining the Italian league, cup and Champions League titles. For Moratti, who bought Inter in 1995, ownership also meant close relationships with players he came to regard as friends.

He founded Inter Campus with his family and the club, using football to give disadvantaged children opportunities to play and learn. The programme worked with local partners across countries and developed activities for children with learning disabilities and young patients receiving cancer treatment.
